patch.value: GH-1757: credential refusal next_steps tell agents to restore the redacted URL credentials before replay, which reproduces the same refusal

Reported in GH-1757 against 2026.11.18. When pm claim is refused because the author value is a URL that carries userinfo (via --author or PM_AUTHOR), the refusal correctly redacts the userinfo in recovery.attempted_command. But its next_steps tell the agent to restore the redacted credentials before replaying, and following that advice reproduces the byte-identical refusal. The guidance should instead steer to a replay that can succeed: an author value without URL credentials. The refusal-redaction work that introduced the redaction is related.

The refusal's next_steps never advise restoring redacted URL credentials when those credentials are the cause of the refusal; Following the emitted next_steps leads to a successful claim; Covered for both the --author flag and PM_AUTHOR

A refusal caused by URL credentials in the author value gives next_steps that lead to a successful replay, such as using an author value without URL credentials, and never advises restoring the redacted credentials.
next_steps say to restore the redacted URL credentials before replaying; doing so reproduces the identical refusal, while a plain author retry succeeds.
